text:
ana_partnerships: quick thread to lock down SI co-sell handoffs for the marketplace + HW launch. goals: no stalled leads, clear crediting, simple ops flow.

sam_sales: two quick q's — how do we mark SI-introduced vs marketplace? SLA to claim?

mike_se: SI-introduced = partner intro email OR fastpass token. fastpass valid 72h. claim windows: hot=48h, warm=72h. set SFDC tags: partner_origin, si_name, listing_id.

rachel_ps: marketing will make 1-pager + 2 outreach templates and an "SI-enabled" badge. need legal signoff for logos.

jordan_ops: ops will add fields (fastpass_token, partner_score, hw_tag) + "SI claimed" status. webhook -> partner endpoint on claim. alert #partner-triage if expired.

lee_hwpartner: HW ask: flag hw_tag for demo kit shipping; need >=72h lead time.

legal_bot: Reminder: LOA required for co-billing > $50k. legal review required for joint press and logos.

ana_partnerships: action items: sam compile partner overrides by Tue; mike finalize routing snippet; rachel draft assets by Fri; jordan prototype webhook in staging by Mon. syncing Mon 10am PT. :thumbsup:
